$description: Binary or mixed-state selection control with native semantics, persistent visible label and touch-friendly target.
name: Checkbox

behavior.interaction: Toggle via label and control, supporting keyboard Space on web.
behavior.indeterminate: Mixed is a programmatic state, not a third permanently cycling value; activation follows application-defined behavior.
behavior.disabled: Disable input and label interaction, with programmatic and visible states.

accessibility: Use actual checkbox semantics and expose checked, unchecked and mixed states appropriately.
Provide an associated label; do not require precise taps on the visual 16px box.
Selection must be communicated by the checkmark/mixed mark, never color alone.
Keep the combined label/control hit area at platform-appropriate minimum size.

web: Use semantic HTML controls, keyboard focus-visible, and 24×24 CSS px minimum targets; prefer more space for touch.
Retain browser zoom and allow labels to wrap or controls to grow.
Use <input type=checkbox>; set the indeterminate DOM property for mixed state when needed.
ios: Respect 44pt minimum interactive hit area and Dynamic Type; prefer native Button/Control semantics.
Use native enabled/disabled and accessibility label/state APIs.
android: Respect 48dp minimum interactive target and nonlinear font scaling; prefer native Compose/View control semantics.
Use native enabled/disabled and accessibility semantics.
